description: TLDR Fintech issue. Revised after real eval runs (2026-10-22, 2026-10-27) showed the original assertion was wrong: this issue is NOT mostly off-domain — alongside the FTX/Netflix drama and a pure Marqeta ad (genuinely off-domain, must drop), it contains OpenAI's reported $50B-vs-$70B revenue dispute, Revolut testing AI shopping agents, and two opinion pieces with real numbered theses about AI reshaping finance. The OpenAI item's correct development_type is genuinely ambiguous across runs (funding, research, and opinion have all been produced, each defensibly — it's a disputed-figure story, not a clean new fact) so the check only requires the item exists and is about OpenAI, not a specific type. The real failure mode to catch is dropping *irrelevant* pop-culture/ad content while correctly keeping the AI-finance content that happens to share the issue.
